title: World Bloom — Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future — Episode10 Toward That Starry Sky

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future
meta.Event Outline: The VIRTUAL SINGER version of Leo/need's debut song is generating buzz, and Ichika and the others couldn't be happier. As the band renews their vow to make it as pros, a new area appears in SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's see... Saki and Shiho should be...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait.
Our class sort of dragged on for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's okay.
Anyway, let's start eating. I'm starved.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Not so fast! I have an incredibly important announcement to make!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, are you gonna tell us about that new area in SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I got to go yesterday after KAITO told me about it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Fine, Shiho, you already know.
But I can still surprise Ichi and Hona! Anyway, this new area appeared in SEKAI and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also went to see it the other day...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! You too, Ichi?!
Th-Then, does that mean...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I really wanted to surprise you guys...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's too bad.
But to be fair, I was gonna offer to show everyone if you hadn't brought it up, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Still, it was so strange.
Those tracks just seemed to extend out towards that sky. How far do you think they go?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean we get to go on a big adventure?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Would you like to go on that train?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah!
How fun would that be?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get how you feel...
I do also want to try boarding it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, why don't we go over after school? I was actually just thinking that we should have practice in SEKAI today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've been here a few times already, but the way that sky twinkles really is beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I bet we'll get to see a bunch of shooting stars!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Miku and the others!
Hey!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
We came to see if we can board the train!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, will the doors open for us?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They wouldn't open when I came the other day, so I'm wondering if they will this time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it, they were also shut tight when I visited...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Really? They opened when I came.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?!
Does that mean you've already been on it, Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, not yet.
I decided to wait until we could all get on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
You seem so surprised...
Anyway, let's try boarding it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That was amazing! What did you do, Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe it was just the right time. Anyway, let's board.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. This is so exciting.
Where do you think it's gonna take us?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm also a little scared about being taken somewhere we've never been before...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is our SEKAI, so I'm sure it's going to take us someplace wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even if it's somewhere we've never been, I'm sure it'll be fun if we all go together♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh?
You guys aren't coming with us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This is your SEKAI.
So, you four should be the first to go.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If anything happens or causes you trouble, we'll run right over to help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're going to go as far as we can!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where do you think it's going to take them?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Somewhere super spectacular! It's for sure gonna be all glittery and sparkly♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, if they do end up in a challenging or difficult situation...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll be able to find a way to overcome it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It should end up being a fun journey...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Umm, everyone? Any idea what this is?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But this SEKAI was born out of those girls' feelings, so it must also have something to do with them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, let's keep watch over this sprout.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
I'll give it water every day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But not too much, okay? It'll start to wilt.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I don't know what's going to happen to this sprout.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But what we do isn't going to change.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (We'll keep watching over it like we always have for the girls.)
